an4.268:1.1: [catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…] attanā ca pisuṇāvāco hoti, parañca pisuṇāvācāya samādapeti, pisuṇāvācāya ca samanuñño hoti, pisuṇāvācāya ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe… [yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.] [catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…]
an4.268:2.1: attanā ca pisuṇāvācā paṭivirato hoti, parañca pisuṇāvācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti, pisuṇāvācā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, pisuṇāvācā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe…
